# Run Kitty Run

> Run Kitty Run (full title Project: Run Kitty Run, also written RunKittyRun or RKR) is a free online co-op game played in the web browser at https://runkittyrun.fun. Players are kitties in a square-spiral labyrinth full of wolves: reach the heart of the labyrinth, don't touch the wolves, and revive fallen teammates by running over their circle. 1 to 32 players per online lobby, plus solo and two-player local co-op. No download, no account and no ads. It is an independent game inspired by the classic Warcraft 3 custom map of the same name and is not affiliated with Blizzard Entertainment.

Key facts:
- Price: free. Platform: any modern browser on computers, phones and tablets (cross-play in the same lobbies).
- Modes: Run + Skate, Run only, Skate only, each as Normal or Easy. Eight levels through the seasons.
- Playing with friends: create a lobby under Multiplayer and share the 4-letter code or invite link.
- Made by Benjamin and Maximilian. Launched 2 October 2026.
